items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of all messages sent to the client outbound channel.
items.translation: 配置一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer` 以应用于发送到客户端出站通道的所有消息的标头。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to pass on to HandlerMethodReturnValueHandlers that send messages from controller return values.
items.translation: 配置一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer` 传递给将控制器返回值发送为消息的 `HandlerMethodReturnValueHandlers`。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of Messages from decoded STOMP frames.
items.translation: 配置一个 MessageHeaderInitializer 以应用于解码后的 STOMP 帧的 Messages 的标头。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of all messages created through the SimpMessagingTemplate.
items.translation: 配置一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer`，使其适用于通过 `SimpMessagingTemplate` 创建的所有消息的标头。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of all messages created through the StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler that are sent to the client outbound message channel.
items.translation: 配置一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer`，使其适用于通过 `StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler` 创建并发送到客户端出站消息通道的所有消息的标头。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of all messages sent to the client outbound channel.
items.translation: 配置一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer` 以应用于发送到客户端出站通道的所有消息的标头。

items.source: Configure a custom MessageHeaderInitializer to initialize the headers of resolved target messages.
items.translation: 配置自定义的MessageHeaderInitializer以初始化解析后的目标消息的标头。

items.source: A MessageHeaderInitializer to customize the strategy for ID and TIMESTAMP message header generation.
items.translation: 一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer` 用于自定义 ID 和 TIMESTAMP 消息头生成的策略。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of all messages created from decoded STOMP frames and other messages sent to the client inbound channel.
items.translation: 配置一个 MessageHeaderInitializer，使其适用于从解码的 STOMP 帧创建的所有消息以及发送到客户端入站通道的其他消息的标头。
